Jun 13, 2025 TPCi Announcements (date approximate), TPCi Rules Team (2025-06-05)

q: If I have Archeops with the "Ancient Wing" Ability in play and my opponent has an Evolution Pokemon directly in play with no lower stages underneath it, can I devolve it and if so, what happens?
a: No, if an Evolution Pokemon that has been put directly into play cannot devolve since there is no Pokemon to devolve it into.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I have a Luminous Energy as the only Special Energy attached to Conkeldurr with the "Craftsmanship" Ability, does Conkeldurr get +40 HP?
a: Yes, it does.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I have a Prism Energy attached to Conkeldurr with the "Craftsmanship" Ability, does it get +40 HP?
a: No it does not, because Conkeldurr is not a Basic Pokemon.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I'm going first and I have an active Meloetta ex with the "Debut Performance" Ability, can I attach a TM:Evolution and use its "Evolution" attack on my first turn?
a: Yes, with Debut Performance Meloetta ex can use any attacks it has access to.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: Can I use Eelektrik from BW:Noble Victories in Standard Format when Eelektrik from SV:Black Bolt is legal?
a: No, there is a significant text difference between the two cards. The card from Black Bolt specifies Basic Energy while the older card does not.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If a Klingklang with "Emergency Rotation" has been put directly into play, will Ignition Energy provide three {*} Energy to it?
a: Yes, as long as the Evolution Pokemon says "Evolves from..." on it Ignition Energy will provide three {*} Energy.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: Does Serperior ex's "Regal Cheer" Ability stack?
a: Yes, it does.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I have more than one Samurott in play, can I use "Torrential Whirlpool" for each one?
a: Sure, that would work.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I have multiple Durant on my bench, does my Active Durant's "Bite Together" attack to +20 for each one?
a: No, you only get a maximum of +20 no matter how many Durant are on your bench.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I use Litwick's "Brighten and Burn" attack and choose to not discard that card, what do I do with it?
a: You put it back on top of your deck if you don't discard it.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I have a Tera Pokemon on my Bench when I use Landorus' "Earthquake" attack, do they take 10 damage or not?
a: No, the Tera Trait protects them from damage by your own attacks as well.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I use Meloetta ex's "Echoed Voice" attack three turns in a row, would I do 190 damage on the third turn?
a: No, the bonus damage doesn't keep stacking. It is only applied for each next turn, so you would do 30, 110, 110, etc.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: What happens if I use my Cofagrigus' "Extended Damagriiigus" attack to move damage from one of my benched Pokemon to my opponent's Antique Cover Fossil with "Protective Cover" Ability?
a: Your benched Pokemon would remove its damage counters, but the opponent's Antique Cover Fossil would not remove nor receive any. If you try to move damage *to* something that blocks effects, the damage disappears. If you try to move damage *from* something that blocks effects, the damage stays there.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I use Ducklett's "Firefighting" attack, can I discard a Prism Energy from my opponent's Active Pokemon?
a: Yes, assuming that Prism Energy is attached to a Basic Pokemon. But Prism Energy does not count as {R} Energy when attached to non-Basic Pokemon.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I use Keldeo ex's "Gale Thrust" attack after I move it up to replace a Pokemon that was KO'd by an opponent's attack, does it do the extra 90 damage?
a: No, Keldeo ex was moved to the Active Spot during the opponent's turn, not during "this turn".
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I use Roggenrola's "Harden" attack and my opponent switches it to my bench, can I prevent any bench damage of 40 or less done to Roggenrola from my opponent's attacks?
a: No, once Roggenrola leaves the Active Spot the effect of Harden goes away.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: After Roggenrola uses its "Harden" attack, is the prevented damage amount calculated before or after Weakness/Resistance?
a: Weakness & Resistance are factored in before determining whether Harden blocks it or not. So if a Grass Pokemon's attack does 30 damage to Roggenrola and then +30 more is added for Roggenrola's Weakness, Harden would not prevent the damage. However, if the Grass Pokemon's attack does 20 damage to Roggenrola and then +20 more is added for Roggenrola's Weakness, Harden would prevent the damage.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If Maractus has no damage on it but I played Fennel this turn, does its "Lively Needles" attack do 100 more damage or not?
a: If you did not remove any damage counters the Pokemon is not "healed" by Fennel, so Lively Needles would only do the base 20 damage.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If I get some heads on Stoutland's "Odor Sleuth" attack, can I choose to take 0 cards from my discard pile to my hand?
a: No, you must take at least one if you are able to.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If my opponent KO's my Active non-ex Pokemon with a Legacy Energy attached and they take no Prize cards, would I get the extra benefits from Terrakion's "Retaliate" attack on my next turn?
a: Yes, you would. Even though the Pokemon with Legacy Energy attached does not give up a prize card, it still counts as a KO'd Pokemon.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: If my opponent's Active Pokemon has a Retreat Cost of {C}{C}{C} printed on its card and it has an Air Balloon attached, how much damage will Throh's "Shoulder Throw" attack be reduced by?
a: The opponent's Retreat Cost is {C} thanks to Air Balloon, so Shoulder Throw only does 30 less damage.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: Can I search for a Special Energy card with Hilda?
a: Yes you can. Hilda does not specify that the Energy card must be Basic Energy.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: Can you use N's Plan to move two Energy cards that provide more than one Energy each?
a: Yes, you can. If you have energy cards attached that provide multiple energy, you may choose one or more energy from each of those cards until you meet the Energy requirement of N's Plan. For example, you could move either 1 or 2 Double Turbo Energy cards.
source: Black Bolt/White Flare FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-07-17)

q: Is there an order to Gumshoos' "Evidence Gathering" Ability? For example, can a player look at the top card before picking a card from their hand to put on the top of your deck? Or do they have to pick the card from their hand first?
a: The text of Evidence Gathering says to switch the card. This happens at the same time, so no you do not get to look at the top card of your deck first.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)
Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Does Pyroar's "Intimidating Fang" Ability reduce my opponent's Attack's damage, even when done to a Benched Pokemon?
a: Intimidating Fang says, "attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokemon do 30 less damage." Since it does not specifically designate Active or Benched Pokemon it reduces damage by -30 to each Pokemon that would be damaged by the opponent's attack.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Does Pyroar's "Intimidating Fang" Ability reduce damage from "Shred" attacks?
a: Yes, it does. The effect of Intimidating Fang is on the Attacking Pokemon (not on Pyroar), so Shred's condition of "any effects on your opponent's Active Pokemon" does not apply.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Does Garganacl's "Powerful a-Salt" Ability stack?
a: Yes, it does.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Can I move a Special Energy that provides {G} with Mega Venusaur's "Solar Transfer" Ability?
a: No, Solar Transfer specifies Basic {G} Energy only.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Does Spiritomb's "Spiteful Swirl" Ability work from the Bench?
a: Yes, it does.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Does Spiritomb's "Spiteful Swirl" Ability stack?
a: Yes, it does.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I use Mega Lucario's "Aura Jab" attack but do not want to attach energy, can I choose to attach zero energy?
a: Yes. Even though you may have Basic {F} Energy cards in your discard pile, when an attack says "up to X" you can choose any number between 0 and the maximum.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25); TPCi Rules Team (2026-02-19)

q: If one of my Pokemon has the least HP remaining and I use Inteleon's "Bring Down" attack, would it Knock Out my own Pokemon?
a: Yes! And your opponent gets to take the Prize card(s) for it.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If my opponent uses Inteleon's "Bring Down" attack on the 'wrong' Pokemon, can they take it back or do they have to use "Bring Down" no matter what – even if it means Knocking Out their own Pokemon?
a: Your opponent must use the Bring Down attack once announced. If they called an invalid target, they must choose a valid one, even if that is one of their own Pokemon.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: What happens if Inteleon uses its "Bring Down" attack, but the lowest HP Pokemon is protected by some effect like Mist Energy?
a: The Pokemon with Mist Energy attached would still be chosen with Bring Down, but it will not get Knocked Out because the protection of Mist Energy prevents all effects (including automatic KO) except damage done to that Pokemon.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I use Pachirisu's "Electrified Incisors" attack and during their next turn my opponent retreats their Active Pokemon, is the new Active Pokemon still affected by Electrified Incisors?
a: No, it is not. Even though Electrified Incisors says "during your opponent's next turn" the effect of the attack is on the Defending Pokemon, not on your opponent. Retreating clears the effect.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I use Hypno's "Pendulum Influence" attack to use Mega Manectric ex's "Riotous Blasting" attack, can I do the extra damage even if I have only 1 Energy to discard?
a: Yes, Riotous Blasting has you choose whether or not you want to do the extra damage, and then you discard all Energy if you can. If you only have 1 Energy attached to Hypno and choose to do the extra damage, you would discard 1 Energy. Even if you were able to use Riotous Blasting with 0 Energy attached to your Pokemon, you could choose to do the extra damage.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I've already played a Supporter this turn and use Ninetales' "Supernatural Shapeshifter" attack, can I still use the effect of a Supporter I discard from my deck?
a: Yes, you can. You are not playing a second supporter, but using its effect via an attack.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I'm not allowed to play a Supporter card for some reason, can I still use Ninetales' "Supernatural Shapeshifter" attack to use the effect of a Supporter?
a: Sure. You are not playing the Supporter, just using its effect.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I use Ninetales' "Supernatural Shapeshifter" attack but I don't want to use the revealed Supporter card, can I choose not to use it?
a: No, you cannot. If you use the attack, you must use the Supporter card if it is revealed and if you are able to.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I use Acerola's Mischief on my Active Pokemon and the chosen Pokemon is moved to the bench, does the protection get removed?
a: No. It is not an attack effect, so it does not get removed by moving to the bench.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: With the "Forest of Vitality" Stadium in play, could I evolve from Bulbasaur to Ivysaur to Venusaur all in the same turn?
a: Yes, as long as it isn't your first turn of the game. Bulbasaur can evolve into Ivysaur on the turn it comes into play, and since Ivysaur has come into play that turn the stadium would allow it to evolve into Venusaur right away too.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Does Iron Defender stack?
a: Yes, it does. All of your {M} Pokemon take 30 less damage, so if you play 2 of them and your opponent uses an attack that does 60 damage to all of your Pokemon, none of your {M} Pokemon would take any damage.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Can I use Mystery Garden if I don't have any cards left in my deck?
a: No, you cannot use the effect of Mystery Garden unless you can draw at least 1 card.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Can I use Mystery Garden if I won't be able to draw cards?
a: No, you can't just discard an Energy card for no draw.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If Risky Ruins is in play and I use Nest Ball or Buddy Buddy Poffin to put Basic non-{D} Pokemon onto my Bench, do I place 2 damage counters on them?
a: Yes, Risky Ruins doesn't care how you put the Basic onto your Bench.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: Can I use Wally's Compassion to heal a Mega Evolution Pokemon ex that doesn't have any Energy attached?
a: Yes, you can.
source: Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)
Mega Evolution FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-09-25)

q: If I have both Meganium with the "Wild Growth" Ability and Venusaur with the "Jungle Totem" Ability in play, does each Basic Grass energy count as 4 Grass energy?
a: No. Each Ability is a replacement effect, not an additive effect. So one would replace the other and you would still wind up with each Basic Grass energy providing 2 Grass energy.

q: If I have Meganium with the "Wild Growth" Ability in play, does my Teal Mask Ogerpon ex's "Myriad Leaf Shower" attack do +90 or +180 more damage if there are only 3 basic {G} energy cards attached to it and no energy on the Defending Pokemon?
a: You get +180 more damage. When an effect counts "attached" energy you count the total amount of energy including the amount added by abilities like Wild Growth.

q: If Dusknoir is Active and uses its "Cursed Blast" Ability to put damage counters on the opponent's Active Pokemon resulting in a Knock Out, which player puts out a new Active Pokemon first?
a: The player whose turn would be next takes their prizes first and then the other player takes their prizes. Then the player whose turn would be next promotes a new Active Pokemon if needed, followed by the other player if they need to promote a new Active Pokemon.

q: If both players have only one Prize card left and my opponent's Dusknoir uses its "Cursed Blast" Ability to Knock Out my Pokemon, who wins?
a: If one player has a Benched Pokemon to put into the Active Spot and the other doesn't, the player who can send out a new Pokemon wins. If both players can or neither player can the game goes to a Tiebreaker Game, or if there is no time left the game counts as incomplete.

q: Can I use Ludicolo's "Excited Heal" Ability, if my only Mega Pokemon in play is Mega Heracross ex?
a: Yes, you can. Excited Heal does not require the {G} Mega Evolution Pokemon ex to be an evolved Pokemon.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: For the "Multi Adapter" Ability of Rotom ex, does it also apply to Fan Rotom?
a: Sure, any Pokemon with Rotom in its name qualifies.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: I play Flygon from my hand and use its "Sandy Flapping" Ability. Do I get to use the Ability again when it is Knocked Out?
a: Yes, both of those uses are specified on the card. This double use is familiar to all you Stoutland players that use its Arf Arf Bark Ability!
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: Say I have Mega Gengar ex with the "Shadowy Concealment" Ability in play. If my opponent Knocks Out my {D} Active Pokemon with Legacy Energy attached, how many prize cards would they take?
a: If the KO'd Pokemon is a Mega Evolution ex Pokemon, they would take 1 Prize. If it is a regular Pokemon ex, they would take 0 Prizes. If it is a non-ex (or any other non-Rule Box Pokemon), they would also take 0 Prizes. In all cases, Legacy Energy counts as being "used" and cannot reduce Prizes taken again later in the game.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If one of my Pokemon was KO'd last turn by damage and Mega Gengar ex's "Shadowy Concealment" Ability kept my opponent from taking a prize for it, will I get to do the bonus damage if I use Krookodile's "Vengeful Fang" attack?
a: Yes, because your Pokemon was still Knocked Out even if your opponent didn't take a prize card for it.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: Can I use Toxtricity's "Sinister Surge" Ability to KO one of my own benched Pokemon?
a: Of course, if it only has 20 or less HP left. Your opponent will take prize card(s)for the KO.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If I have Mismagius ex with the "Swirling Prose" Ability active and I Knock Out the opponent's Active Pokemon, is the new Active Pokemon Confused?
a: No, because that replacement happens during your turn, not during theirs.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If my Lokix is Confused and successfully uses its "Jumping Shot" attack against my opponent's Mismagius ex with the "Swirling Prose" Ability, will the new Pokemon I send out be Confused?
a: No, it will not.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: For Suicune's "Crystal Fall" attack, if I have 3 Basic {W} and one Prism Energy in play, do I get its +90 bonus damage?
a: Yes, the effect of Crystal Fall does not specify Basic Energy cards.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If I use Gloom's "Disperse Drool" attack and have a Teal Mask Ogerpon ex on my Bench, do I do 20 damage to my Teal Mask Ogerpon ex?
a: No. Tera Pokemon are protected from damage on the bench even from your own attacks.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If I flip any heads for Smeargle's "Energizing Sketch" attack, can I choose not to attach a Basic Energy from my discard pile?
a: Yes, you can choose not to attach any energy.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13); TPCi Rules Team (2026-04-16)

q: For Ceruledge's "Infernal Slash" attack, what happens if I only have three {R} Energy cards in my hand?
a: If you cannot discard 4 Basic {R} Energy cards the attack does nothing. You can't even discard those three cards from your hand.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If an attack placed damage counters on Mega Heracross ex last turn, would I do that much extra damage with its "Juggernaut Horn" attack on my turn?
a: No, it would not. Placing damage counters is not the same as doing damage.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If I use Munkidori's "Adrena-Brain" Ability to move 3 damage counters from Vileplume, would Vileplume's "Lively Flower" attack do +120 more damage or not?
a: No. Moving damage counters is not the same thing as Healing, so Lively Flower would not do any additional damage due to Adrena-Brain.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: Would my Paldean Tauros' "Raging Charge" attack count a damaged Tauros in its damage calculation?
a: Yes, any damaged Pokemon with Tauros in its name counts in the calculation. However, since Paldean Tauros and Tauros are Pokemon with different names you could have 4 Paldean Tauros and 2 Tauros from Destined Rivals in play, and any of them that are damaged would add +40 to the Raging Charge attack.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If Pawmot already has 100 damage on it, can I choose to do 60 damage to Pawmot with its "Voltaic Fist" attack in order to Paralyze the Defending Pokemon even though it would knock out my Pawmot?
a: Yes, there is no restriction to prevent that. The Defending Pokemon will still be damaged and Paralyzed, and then you check for Knock Outs, including Pawmot.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If Battle Cage is in play and I use Munkidori's "Adrena-Brain" Ability to try and move 3 damage counters from one of my Pokemon to one of my opponent's Benched Pokemon, what happens?
a: The three damage counters are removed from your Pokemon, but since they cannot be placed onto Benched Pokemon they just vanish from play.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If I use Grimsley's Move, can I put a Stage 1 or Stage 2 {D} Pokemon directly onto my Bench?
a: Yes, when using this Supporter you can place any stage of {D} Pokemon you find directly onto your bench.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: Can I use Jacq to search for Mega Absol ex since it's a "Mega-Evolved Pokemon"?
a: No, you cannot. Mega Evolution is not an evolution stage, but the Mega-Evolved form of Absol. For Jacq you check the Stage in the upper left, which for Mega Absol ex is "Basic" and therefore cannot be chosen.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: Say I have Sacred Charm attached to my Active Pokemon while Team Rocket's Watchtower is in play. If my opponent attacks with a colorless Pokemon that has an Ability printed on the card, does my Active Pokemon still take 30 less damage?
a: No, Team Rocket's Watchtower says colorless Pokemon "have no Abilities", so as long as the Stadium is in play the 30 damage will not be prevented.
source: Phantasmal Flames FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2025-11-13)

q: If Battle Cage is in play and I am using Gardevoir ex's "Psychic Embrace" Ability to put a {P} Energy onto my Benched Psychic Pokemon from the discard pile, do I still put 2 damage counters on that Pokemon?
a: Yes, Battle Cage only blocks the placement of damage counters onto your opponent's Benched Pokemon. It does not block the placement of damage counters onto your own Pokemon from your own attacks or Abilities.

q: If I knock out my opponent's only Mega Gengar ex that is in play, do I still take one less Prize card?
a: Yes, the "Shadowy Concealment" Ability is triggered by the KO, so it still reduces the number of prize cards taken even though Mega Gengar ex is in the discard pile at the time when prize cards are taken.

q: Do I have to choose all three card stages when using Dawn?
a: No, you do not. Any deck search for specific types of cards can choose to fail any or all of them because the deck contents are private. You can get one, two, all three, or even none of the cards if you so choose.

q: If Dusknoir uses its "Cursed Blast" Ability and targets an opponent's Benched Pokemon while Battle Cage is in play, would Dusknoir be Knocked Out even though it placed no damage counters?
a: Yes. It still used the Ability even though the placement of the damage counters was blocked by Battle Cage. So Dusknoir is Knocked Out.

q: When using Mega Lopunny ex's "Gale Thrust" attack, what counts as "moving to the Active Spot this turn"?
a: Your turn starts when you draw a card. If Mega Lopunny ex moved to the Active Spot prior to that, it is not during your turn. For example, if your opponent KO'd your Active at the end of their turn, moving Mega Lopunny ex to the Active Spot at that time is during their turn. Or if your Active was KO'd by Poison during Pokemon Checkup between turns, that is also not during your turn. And finally, if Buneary moved to the Active Spot during your turn and then evolved into Mega Lopunny ex, that would not count because it was Buneary when it moved to the Active Spot.

q: If I played Canari this turn and I have 2 Heliolisk in play, can I use each of their "Frilled Generator" Abilities?
a: Yes, each Heliolisk can use its Ability. The "once during your turn" refers to each Ability individually.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If I have two Team Rocket's Dugtrio with the "Holes" Ability in play and my opponent Retreats their Active Pokemon, do they place 2 or 4 damage counters on it?
a: They place 4 damage counters. The Ability can stack.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If Battle Cage is in play, what happens if my opponent switches or retreats their Active Pokemon to the bench while I have a Team Rocket's Dugtrio with the "Holes" Ability in play?
a: Their Pokemon is on the bench when the Ability is applied, so it takes no damage counters thanks to Battle Cage.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If my opponent uses N's Zekrom's "Shred" attack and does enough damage to KO my Mega Hawlucha ex, do I get to flip a coin for its "Tenacious Body" Ability?
a: The full damage will be done by Shred, but then if the coin flip for Tenacious Body is heads 10 HP is restored to Mega Hawlucha ex AFTER all the damage is done. Mega Hawlucha ex would not be KO'd.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If I have Meganium with "Wild Growth" Ability on the bench and Teal Mask Ogrepon with 2 Basic Grass Energy attached in the Active Spot, can I use its "Myriad Leaf Shower" attack if Nighttime Mine Stadium is in play?
a: Yes, you can. Wild Growth counts the 2 Basic Grass energy cards as 4 energy, so you satisfy the new attack cost of 4 Energy due to the Nighttime Mine.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If my opponent's N's Vanilluxe uses its "Blizzard" attack and there is a Battle Cage Stadium in play, would Benched Pokemon be protected from taking 10 damage each?
a: No. Doing damage is not an effect and is different from placing damage counters. Battle Cage only protects against placing damage counters, not damage done, even if that damage came from the attack text.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: Can I use Mega Charizard Y ex's "Explosion Y" attack if I have two Basic Fire Energy and a Counter Gain tool attached to it if I'm behind on Prizes?
a: Yes, even though you are only discarding two Energy you can use the attack.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If I use Entei's "Flare Fall" attack but I only have 3 Basic Fire Energy in play, will my one Prism Energy count and let me do damage?
a: Yes, that works (as long as Prism Energy is attached to a Basic Pokemon). Flare Fall does not specifically say the energy has to be Basic Energy.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If I use Rotom's "Roto Call" attack can I get Fan Rotom and Rotom ex and put them on my Bench?
a: If you have room on your bench, yes. Any Pokemon that has "Rotom" in their name can be chosen.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If N's Vanilluxe uses its "Snow Coating" attack on a Pokemon that already has two damage counters on it, does it place four more damage counters on that Pokemon for a total of six?
a: No, that's not now it works. Snow Coating counts how many damage counters are already on the Pokemon and places the same number of additional damage counters on it. So in your example a Pokemon with two damage counters would now have a total of four on it, not six.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If there is a Battle Cage in play, and I use N's Vanilluxe's "Snow Coating" attack, what happens if my opponent has a Benched Pokemon with 3 damage counters on it?
a: Doubling the number of damage counters requires damage counters to be placed. So the damage counters would not be added to your opponent's Benched Pokemon; it would be protected by the Battle Cage.
source: Ascending Heroes FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-01-22)

q: If there are two Froslass with "Freezing Shroud" Ability and one Garganacl with "Blessed Salt" Ability in play, during Pokemon Checkup can you choose to apply one Froslass' "Freezing Shroud" first, then Garganacl's "Blessed Salt", and finally the other Froslass' "Freezing Shroud"?
a: The player whose turn will be next can decide the order of which these effects will be applied.

q: If I use Flareon ex's "Burning Charge" attack but I don't want to attach any Fire Energy to my Pokemon, do I still have to search & shuffle my deck?
a: Yes. Even though you are going to fail the search, you still have to shuffle your deck.

q: If I have {F} Energy in my discard pile, do I have to attach at least one of them to Regirock ex if I use its "Regi Charge" attack?
a: No, you don't have to attach any if you don't want to.

q: My opponent has a Charizard ex with 300 damage on the bench. I play Gravity Mountain stadium to replace Area Zero Underdepths. What happens first, Knock Out the Charizard ex or bench reduction?
a: You complete the effects of the stadium change first, so you have to discard Pokemon, if needed. Therefore, you may discard Charizard ex first and then check for KO's afterward.

q: If my opponent has zero cards in their hand, can I use Vivillon's "Grand Wing" Ability even though it won't do anything?
a: No. If they have no cards in their hand, you can't use the Ability.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If my Gengar with "Infinite Shadow" Ability is Knocked Out by damage from my opponent's attack and I put it into my hand, does the opponent get to take a Prize for it?
a: Yes. It was still Knocked Out even though Gengar is going to your hand instead of to the discard pile.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If my Gengar with "Infinite Shadow" Ability is Knocked Out by damage from my opponent's attack, do I also put the underlying Gastly & Haunter cards into my hand or just the Gengar card?
a: The phrase "this Pokemon" includes the underlying Basic & Stage cards that got it to the point of being Gengar, so those underlying cards would get put into your hand as well.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: What happens if both Mega Clefable ex with the "Luminous Wing" Ability and Iron Thorns ex with the "Initialization" Ability are in play?
a: Luminous Wing takes precedence over Initialization. It doesn't matter which one comes into play first.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I have a Turtonator with "Shell Spikes" Ability active, what happens if it gets damaged by an opponent's attack by a Pokemon that has a Mist Energy attached to it?
a: Mist Energy only prevents effects of attacks and Shell Spikes is an Ability, so you will get to discard your choice of an energy card from the attacking Pokemon.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I have Relicanth with the "Memory Dive" Ability in play and my opponent has 4 cards in their hand, can my Decidueye ex with "Sniper's Eye" Ability use its underlying Dartrix's "Feather Shot" attack for no energy?
a: Yes. Sniper's Eye removes all colorless energy costs from any attack that Decidueye ex can use.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: Can I move a special energy card like Legacy Energy with Dewgong's "Wash Out" Ability?
a: Yes, as long as the Energy card is providing {W} Energy. It does not specify that the energy card has to be Basic.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I use Mawile's "Double Eater" attack, can I discard zero energy cards from my hand if I want to?
a: Yes you can, and then it would do zero damage. But it would still count as doing an attack.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I use Klefki's "Memory Lock" attack on my opponent's Active Pokemon and they Retreat and Switch that same Pokemon back to the Active spot, can they use the chosen attack?
a: Yes, they can. Even though the term "Active Pokemon" was used, the "lock" is still an attack effect that gets removed when that Pokemon goes to the Bench.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I use Salazzle ex's "Nasty Plot" attack and don't find a card that I want in my deck, can I choose to take zero cards?
a: No, you have to take at least one card if there are any cards in your deck.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: How does it work if I use Mega Zygarde ex's "Nullifying Zero" attack and my opponent has any Benched Pokemon?
a: You would flip a coin for each and every Pokemon they have in play. It does not matter the order of which the Pokemon can be chosen. Choose the first Pokemon and if you get heads you put 150 damage on that Pokemon, then move on to the next one. Note that Tera Pokemon can't be damaged on the Bench, but you would still flip for them.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If my opponent used Hippopotas' "Sand Attack" last turn and my Active Pokemon is Confused, do I get to choose which effect I would flip for first when I attack?
a: You would flip for Sand Attack's effect first, then flip for Confusion.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: Can Shaymin's "Send Flowers" attack search for Special Energy as well as Basic Energy?
a: Yes, the attack does not specify the Energy card has to be of any type.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I use Serperior's "Solar Coiling" attack and I have 2 copies of Rosa's Encouragement in my discard pile, do I do 300 more damage?
a: No. It just checks if any Rosa's Encouragement is in the discard pile; it doesn't matter how many are there. The attack would only do 150 more damage.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I used Doublade's "Weaponized Swords" attack and one of the cards I revealed was an Aegislash ex, would I do an extra 60 for it?
a: No, the names of the cards revealed must be an exact match of those listed; "Aegislash ex" is not the same as "Aegislash".
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If I have three Growing {G} Energy attached to one of my Grass Pokemon, do I get a bonus of +60 HP?
a: Yes. The effect will stack.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If my Bench is full and I attach Telepathic {P} Energy to one of my Psychic Pokemon, do I still search and shuffle my deck?
a: No, if your Bench is full you cannot search or shuffle your deck. However, if your Bench is not full you must search and shuffle your deck. You can fail the search if you want, of course.
source: Perfect Order FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-03-26)

q: If my opponent uses Cursed Blast during their turn, which would Knock Out their Dusknoir and allow me to take a face-down Prize card and the prize card is Dream Ball, can I use the effect of Dream Ball to search my deck for a Pokemon and put it onto my Bench even though it is not my turn?
a: Yes, if your bench is not full you can choose to play Dream Ball. If you do, you're going to immediately need to select the Pokemon from your deck and place it on your bench. If Cursed Blast KO'd your Active Pokemon, you must resolve the effect of Dream Ball before the card goes into your hand and before you promote your new Active Pokemon since you take your prizes before promoting your new active. And even if Cursed Blast has KO'd your last Pokemon, you can still use Dream Ball to put a Pokemon onto the bench, then promote it to the active spot.

q: Can I choose to play a Fossil card as one of my starting Pokemon?
a: No, you cannot. It's considered an Item card while in your hand, so it doesn't count as a Basic Pokemon during setup.

q: Can I play a Fossil card onto my bench when there is an effect that prevents me from playing Item cards from my hand, such as Jellicent's "Oceanic Curse" Ability or Budew's "Itchy Pollen" Attack?
a: No. Fossils are considered Item cards when in your hand, and they aren't considered Pokemon until they are in play.

q: If my Active Pokemon is Confused and my opponent used Horsea's "Smokescreen" or Octillery's "Smokescreen Shot" attack on its last turn, do I get to choose which effect I would flip for first when I try to attack during my turn?
a: Since Horsea's Smokescreen says "if tails that attack doesn't happen", you would flip for Smokescreen's effect first to see if the attack happens, then flip for Confusion if the Smokescreen flip was heads.

q: If I use Strange Timepiece to devolve my Active Espeon into Eevee with the "Boosted Evolution" Ability, can I evolve it back to Espeon right away?
a: Yes, the text on Strange Timepiece saying "that Pokemon can't evolve this turn" is in parentheses and therefore is simply reminder text for the normal game rules. The Boosted Evolution Ability overrides normal rules.

q: If I use Strange Timepiece to devolve Grumpig to Spoink on the Bench while Risky Ruins Stadium is in play, do I put 2 damage counters on Spoink or not?
a: No, devolving does not count as putting a Pokemon onto the Bench.

q: If I retreat my Basic Pokemon from the active spot to the bench while Risky Ruins is in play, do I put 2 damage counters on it?
a: No, moving to the bench is not the same as "putting" it onto the bench.

q: Does Empoleon ex's "Emperor's Stance" Ability block the effect of Cynthia's Roserade's "Cheer on to Glory" Ability?
a: No. The effect of Cheer on to Glory is applied to the attacking Cynthia's Pokemon and adds damage to that attack. Since "damage is not an effect", Emperor's Stance does not block it.

q: Will Team Rocket's Watchtower cancel out Meowth ex's "Last-Ditch Catch" Ability when it is played?
a: Yes, Meowth ex will have no Ability when it comes into play.

q: Does Mega Clefable's "Luminous Wing" Ability get through Crustle's "Mysterious Rock Inn" Ability or not?
a: No, the effect of Mysterious Rock Inn is not being done to Mega Clefable ex. It is like a shield on Crustle.

q: If I play Team Rocket's Giovanni and my opponent has an Active Mismagius ex with the "Swirling Prose" Ability, is my new Active Pokemon Confused after it gets switched in?
a: Yes, since their Mismagius ex was active when your new Pokemon is switched in, your new Active Pokemon is now Confused. Also, if you use Team Rocket's Giovanni to bring a Benched Mismagius ex into the Active Spot, Swirling Prose will not work (since your switch happens before Mismagius ex's Swirling Prose is in effect).

q: If I use Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex's "Erasure Ball" attack and choose a Team Rocket's Energy to discard, does that add +60 or +120 damage? Or if it only adds +60, can I choose to discard another Energy card as well?
a: Discarding the Team Rocket's Energy card would do +60 because the attack does +60 for each "card" discarded. If you wanted to, you could choose one energy from TR Energy and one energy from another card (even another Team Rocket's Energy card) and discard both of those cards to do +120 damage.

q: If I use Stunfisk's "Pouncing Trap" attack against a Pokemon that has Mist Energy attached, would my attack do +100 damage next turn to that Pokemon or not?
a: This is a case where the extra damage would NOT be done! Pouncing Trap puts an effect on the Defending Pokemon that would do extra damage in the future. That effect would be blocked by Mist Energy since it is not Damage at that point. And as Mist Energy notes, if you attach it after the effect of Pouncing Trap was applied, it won't remove the existing effect.

q: Can I use Delphox's "Flaring Magic" Ability to discard a {R} energy when I have 8 or more cards in my hand?
a: No. With this ability, you're discarding a {R} energy to pay the cost of using the ability, then draw until you have 7 cards in your hand. But since you already have 7 cards you can't draw any more cards, so you can't even choose to use the ability and you don't get to put the {R} in the discard pile.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I have two Garbodor with the "Gloomy Garbage" Ability in play, would my opponent's Active Pokemon's attacks be reduced by 40 damage?
a: Yes, the effect will stack.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I use Keldeo's "Shoot Through" attack with a Tool attached while my opponent has Garbodor with the "Gloomy Garbage" Ability in play, do I still do 20 damage to a Benched Pokemon?
a: No. Gloomy Garbage will also reduce 20 from damage done to Benched Pokemon as well.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If my Active Pokemon has the "Shred" attack and my opponent has Garbodor with the "Gloomy Garbage" Ability in play, will I do full damage?
a: No! In this case, the effect of Gloomy Garbage is on the Pokemon doing the attack, so it is not something that Shred would get to ignore, since it's not an effect on the Defending Pokemon!
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: My active Chesnaught with "Needly Armor" Ability is damaged by my opponent's Active Pokemon. How many damage counters do I place on the attacking Pokemon if I have two {G} and 1 Legacy Energy attached?
a: Needly Armor counts the total amount of Chesnaught's {G} energy, so in this scenario you would place 9 damage counters ([2 {G} + 1 Legacy] times 3 counters each = 9 counters placed). If that {G} energy count is increased by an Ability such as Meganium's Wild Growth, or provided by a Special Energy, that all is included when calculating damage.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If my opponent has Goodra with "Slimy Sliding" Ability in play and I try to Retreat my Active Pokemon and flip tails, can I try to Retreat again during my turn?
a: No. This uses up your Retreat for the turn even though your Pokemon did not go to the Bench nor pay its Retreat Cost.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: Can I use Phantump's "Spiteful Evolution" Ability on my first turn of the game?
a: No, but after your first turn of the game it can be used on the first turn that Phantump comes into play.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If my Ninetales uses its "Nine-Tailed Transfer" attack while Patrat with the "Watchful Eye" Ability is in play, do I get to remove the damage counters from one of my Benched Pokemon and just discard them?
a: No! You can't move damage counters at all while Watchful Eye is active! They stay where they are. This is different than Battle Cage which only protects the target.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I want to use Ho-Oh's "Flames of Revival" attack and don't want to put any Basic Pokemon from my discard pile onto my bench (or if my bench is full), may I still use the attack?
a: Yes. You are not required to put a Basic Pokemon on your bench to use the attack.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I use Slowking's "Seek Inspiration" attack and discard a Metagross with the "Metallic Hammer" attack, can Slowking do the extra +150 damage if it has no {M} Energy to discard?
a: Yes it can, but if Slowking does have any Metal Energy or Rainbow-like Energy attached it would have to discard as much as it can (up to 3) if you choose to do the extra damage. Otherwise if you choose to not do the extra damage Slowking would get to keep its attached {M} Energy.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: When I use Delibird's "Pleasing Present" attack, my opponent must go first to make a choice of which Basic Energy cards to attach or to attach none at all, right?
a: Yes. Make sure your opponent has executed this choice, then execute your choice. However, if there is some effect that is triggered by the energy attachment, like placing damage counters, note that these Basic Energy cards are all placed at the same time from the game's perspective. You don't resolve the effects of your opponent placing energy cards before you place yours.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I use Delibird's "Pleasing Present" attack, what happens if my opponent chooses to attach energy to their Skeledirge with "Unaware" ability?
a: Because Skeledirge's Unaware "prevents all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokemon done to this Pokemon" the energy cards are discarded, after they execute their choice.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: Does Beedrill ex's "Rumbling Bees" attack include any Beedrill V I have in play?
a: No, Rumbling Bees only counts Beedrill and Beedrill ex, so it wouldn't count things like Beedrill V.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I use Watchog's "Snap Inspection" attack and flip 3 heads, can I just put only one or two cards (or no cards) from their hand back into their deck?
a: You have to do as much as you can. If they have three cards, you have to put all three back into their deck.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: My opponent uses Skuntank's "Smash Turn" attack against my Darkness-weak Active Pokemon and switches out to the Bench. If I have Adversity Policy attached, do I still get to draw 3 cards?
a: Yes, even if the Attacking Pokemon switches to the Bench or leaves play, you would still draw 3 cards for Adversity Policy.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If my Grass-weak Pokemon has Adversity Policy attached and is attacked twice by a Dipplin with the "Festival Lead" Ability and Festival Grounds is in play, would I draw 3 cards or 6 cards in total?
a: Festival Lead allows Dipplin to attack twice, so you would draw 3 cards for each attack or 6 in total.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I only have 2 cards left in my deck and my Pokemon's Adversity Policy Tool is activated from an attack, do I still draw since I can't draw 3 cards?
a: Yes, you do as much as you can. And unless you immediately get cards back into your deck somehow, you will lose at the start of your turn because you can't draw a card to start your turn.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: Can I use Prism Tower if I don't have any cards in my deck?
a: No, you cannot simply discard 2 cards for no effect.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: Can I use Prism Tower if I only have one card in my hand?
a: No, you cannot. You must be able to discard 2 cards in order to use Prism Tower's effect.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I play Roxie's Performance on my turn and then my opponent plays a new Darkness Pokemon to their bench and uses Pecharunt ex's "Subjugating Chains" Ability to move it into the Active Spot (and Poisons it), can that Pokemon retreat since it wasn't in play when Roxie's Performance was played?
a: No, it cannot retreat. Roxie's Performance says "new" Pokemon are also affected.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: Can I play Special Red Card if my opponent has no cards in their hand?
a: If your opponent has no cards in their hand, you can't play Special Red Card.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: What happens if I play just one Transformation Tome?
a: You can't. It has to be two of them at the same time, or you cannot play it at all.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If I have a heavily damaged Basic Pokemon ex in play, can I use two Transformation Tomes to switch it with a regular one-prize Basic Pokemon from my discard pile?
a: Yes, and if the new Basic Pokemon has less HP than the amount of damage counters it is immediately KO'd and will give only one prize to your opponent.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If Mega Emboar ex uses its "Crimson Blast" attack and does enough damage to KO itself, would its attached Nitro {R} Energy go back into the hand?
a: No, Nitro {R} Energy only goes back into the hand when it is discarded as part of an attack, not when it gets discarded due to being KO'd.
source: Chaos Rising FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-05-21)

q: If Mega Clefable ex attacks a Mimikyu with the "Safeguard" Ability, does its attack ignore "Safeguard" because of "Luminous Wing"?
a: No, the protective effect of Safeguard is on Mimikyu, not Mega Clefable ex; so Luminous Wing does not interact with it and the damage is blocked.

q: If my opponent has Milotic with the "Mentally Calm" Ability in play, can I use Mega Greninja ex's "Ninja Spinner" attack to put a Water Energy into my hand?
a: No, you cannot put a Water Energy into your hand. You may CHOOSE to try to do so and will get the bonus damage from Ninja Spinner, but the Water Energy would stay attached to Mega Greninja ex due to Milotic's Mentally Calm ability.

q: If Quaquaval ex uses its "Exciting Dance" attack and both Pokemon go to the bench, would a Spiky Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon still place 2 damage counters on Quaquaval ex?
a: The Quaquaval ex still takes the damage counters from Spiky Energy since it is the Attacking Pokemon. Even though neither Pokemon are still in the Active Spot, the 60 damage from Exciting Dance was done to the Active Defending Pokemon. It doesn't matter where they end up as long as they are still in play.

q: If one of my basic Pokemon takes 30 damage from my opponent's attack, then I use Transformation Tome to swap it with Mega Heracross ex, does that Mega Heracross ex's "Juggernaut Horn" attack deal 30 extra damage?
a: Yes, it would. It is treated as the same Pokemon.

q: If I use Mega Dragalge ex's "Pernicious Poison" attack, does my opponent's Pokemon put 16 damage counters for Poison on their Pokemon only once, or do they keep putting that many upon every Pokemon Checkup between turns?
a: It puts 16 damage counters on every Pokemon Checkup, as long as it survives and has that Poisoned Condition.

q: If I have a damaged Grapploct in the Active Spot with Karate Belt attached and I have more Prize Cards than my opponent, can Grapploct use its "Raging Tentacles" attack with no Energy attached?
a: The attack cost is set at one {F} and is not further reduced. It is an alternate cost that cannot be increased or decreased.

q: If I use Elgyem's "Slight Shift" attack, can I move a Mist Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon onto a different Pokemon?
a: No, you cannot.

q: I use Ninetales' "Supernatural Shapeshifter" attack and discard an Eri. If I look at my opponent's hand and find one Item card and I don't want to discard it, can I choose not to?
a: You cannot normally choose to discard zero Item cards when playing Eri as a Supporter; however per the April 2026 Rulebook update, since you are now using that Supporter as the effect as an Attack, you can choose to discard zero Item cards if you wish.

q: If a player plays Roto-Stick and reveals four Supporter cards and puts all of them into their hand, do they have to shuffle their deck afterwards?
a: Yes, the deck is shuffled.
source: TPCi Rules Team (2026-06-04); TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-09)

q: Mega Greninja ex has a basic Water and a Neo Upper Energy attached and attacks with "Ninja Spinner" while Bastiodon with the "Ancient Bulwark" Ability is on the opponent's Bench. If the Mega Greninja ex player decides to put the Neo Upper Energy back to hand in order to do more damage, would "Ancient Bulwark" prevent the damage?
a: The choice to return the Energy to the hand is made first, but it is not returned to the hand until after damage is done. Mega Greninja ex has 3 Energy attached when the damage is done, so Ancient Bulwark will not prevent the damage.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I have an Antique Armor Fossil or Antique Skull Fossil active and my opponent has a Mega Chandelure ex with the "Binding Flame" Ability in play, does my Antique Armor Fossil or Antique Skull Fossil have a Retreat Cost?
a: No. The text on all Antique Fossil cards say they have no Retreat cost. Not zero, "no" retreat cost. It is a fixed attribute and it cannot be changed.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Does Mega Chandelure's "Binding Flame" Ability stack?
a: Yes, it does.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Can Rampardos ex use its "Destructive Headbutting" Ability to discard an energy from a Pokemon with the "Hide 'n' Sneak" Ability?
a: You can use the Destructive Headbutting Ability but Hide 'n' Sneak will prevent Energy from getting discarded. However, you would not be able to use Destructive Headbutting if the opponent's Active Pokemon has no Energy attached.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If my opponent's Cinderace with the "Explosiveness" Ability was put into play from their starting hand, would my Koraidon's "Battle Claw" attack do +30 more damage to it or not?
a: Yes. Even though Cinderace is not an "Evolved Pokemon" it is still an "Evolution Pokemon" card, and therefore meets the condition of Battle Claw to do the extra damage.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: I used Manectric's "Flashing Barrier" attack last turn and this turn my opponent is attacking with a Cinderace with the "Explosiveness" Ability that had been put into play from their starting hand. Would its attack damage be blocked?
a: Yes. Even though Cinderace is not an "Evolved Pokemon" it is still an "Evolution Pokemon" card, and therefore meets the condition of Flashing Barrier to have its damage blocked.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If my Active Pokemon has the "Hide 'n' Sneak" Ability and my opponent's Rampardos ex attacked with "Rowdy Hammer" last turn, does this turn's attack do +150 more damage to my Active Pokemon?
a: The extra damage done by Rowdy Hammer is due a game state check and damage calculations; it is not an effect that can be blocked by Hide 'n' Sneak. The extra damage for Rowdy Hammer takes place.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If my Miraidon with the "Photon Cord" Ability is Knocked Out by damage from my opponent's Attacking Pokemon, can I choose to move zero Basic {L} Energy cards?
a: No. If you have any Basic {L} Energy cards attached to Miraidon, you must move at least one per the Rule Book. Only attacks can choose zero for "up to" effects.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I have Miraidon in the active spot and my opponent uses Cranidos' "Push Down" attack to KO Miraidon, can I still use Miraidon's "Photon Cord" Ability? And if so, can I choose to have it move the energy to itself?
a: Yes, you would still have the opportunity to use Photon Cord. However, even though Miraidon is on the bench due to Push Down you cannot move the Energy onto itself. Moving means that the Energy has to go to a different Pokemon.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I use Sizzlipede's "Bug Out" attack and reveal 2 Pokemon with the "Bug Out" attack and 2 Pokemon that don't have that attack, do I discard the last two Pokemon?
a: No, all Pokemon get shuffled back into the deck whether they have the Bug Out attack or not. Other non-Pokemon cards like Trainer or Energy cards would get discarded.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: On my opponent's turn they used Manectric's "Flashing Barrier" attack preventing all damage from evolution Pokemon on my next turn. If I use Thievul's "Skill Thief" attack to copy the attack of one of my opponent's Basic Pokemon does it do damage?
a: Thievul is the Pokemon using the attack, which is an Evolution Pokemon. Therefore the damage is prevented.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I use Tropius' "Fruity Aroma" attack and I reveal & put 6 Pokemon into my hand, do I shuffle my deck?
a: No, since you are not putting any cards back into the deck, you do not shuffle your deck.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: My opponent used Jynx's "Intense Kiss" attack last turn. On my turn I retreat the Pokemon that was attacked and bring up a new Pokemon. What happens?
a: Since the Defending Pokemon that Jynx attacked was moved to the Bench, the attack effect which Intense Kiss placed on that Pokemon was removed. Neither the old Active nor the new Active are discarded.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I use Munkidori's "Adrena-Brain" Ability to move 3 damage counters from Lurantis ex, would Lurantis ex's "Lively Cutter" attack do +200 more damage or not?
a: Moving damage counters is not the same thing as Healing, so Lively Cutter would not do any additional damage due to Adrena-Brain.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I use Rampardos ex's "Rowdy Hammer" attack several turns in succession, does the damage keep piling up as 150, 300, 450, 600, etc.?
a: No, Rowdy Hammer tops out at 300. It only adds +150 to the base 150 damage for the next turn only; it does not accumulate on successive turns. Also, if Rampardos ex has access to and uses a different attack on the following turn, that attack would do +150 as long as it initially does some damage.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If Mega Slowbro ex used its "Shellnado Spin" attack last turn, what happens if it gets damaged by an opponent's attack from a Pokemon that has Mist Energy attached to it?
a: Mist Energy prevents effects of attacks, and even though it is a delayed effect Shellnado Spin is still an attack so placing the 12 damage counters would be blocked.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I only have 2 {D} Energy attached to Thievul, can I use its "Skill Thief" attack to copy an attack from one of my opponent's Benched Pokemon that requires 3 {L} Energy?
a: Yes. You do not need to have the Energy that the opponent's Pokemon's attack requires. You just need to be able to do Skill Thief.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I use Spiritomb's "Spiritual End" attack and meet the requirements, what happens if I choose one of my Opponent's Pokemon with 0 damage counters?
a: No damage counters are placed on that Pokemon. For example, 0 times 4 is 0; if it has 1 damage counter 1 times 4 is 4, you would add 3 to make 4 total, etc.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If Battle Cage Stadium is in play and a Benched Pokemon with damage on it is chosen for Spritomb's "Spiritual End" attack, what happens?
a: Placing the damage counters on the Benched Pokemon is blocked.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I use Morpeko ex's "Wheely Draw" attack and I have no cards in my hand, do I shuffle my deck before drawing?
a: Yes. You always have a hand, even if there are zero cards in it.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If my Mega Zeraora ex Knocks Out the Defending Pokemon with its "Zepto Turn" attack, who switches in a new Active Pokemon first, assuming both players have Benched Pokemon?
a: Attack effects are completed before KO's are taken, so you switch Mega Zerora ex to the Bench first and promote a new Active, then your opponent would process the KO and bring up a new Active.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Can I use Backtrack Badge to reflip only the tails flips from an attack?
a: No. You must reflip all of the flips for an attack if you choose to use Backtrack Badge.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Can I use Backtrack Badge to reflip for a Confusion check?
a: No, Backtrack Badge only applies to flips that are done as part of the attack. You cannot use it for checking status effects.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Can I use Dark Bell if both Active Pokemon are {D} type and/or Confused?
a: No, you cannot. You cannot play the card if there are no valid targets.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I have no cards left in my deck, can I still play Gwynn to discard one or two Pokemon from my hand?
a: Yes. You can do as much as you can.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: If I have no cards left in my hand after playing Lillie's Determination, do I shuffle my deck before drawing?
a: Yes. It says to shuffle your hand into your deck and you always have a hand even if there are zero cards left in it. This is different than effects that say to shuffle remaining cards into the deck.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Does Voltaic {L} Energy stack?
a: Yes, if you have multiple copies attached to a {L} Pokemon, each one will add 20 damage.
source: Pitch Black FAQ; TPCi Rules Team (2026-07-16)

q: Does Bastiodon's "Ancient Bulwark" Ability prevent the damage from Banette's "Puppet Pull" attack if only 2 energy are attached to Banette, or does it go through because of Banette's "Hide 'n' Sneak" Ability?.
a: Ancient Bulwark is an effect on all of the Bastiodon player's Pokemon, not an effect on Banette. Therefore, Hide 'n' Sneak does not prevent Ancient Bulwark's protection of the Defending Pokemon from the attack damage. Ancient Bulwark prevents the damage, period.

q: Say I have Bastiodon on my bench, and my opponent has 3 Basic energy attached to their Active Raging Bolt ex. They use its "Bellowing Thunder" attack and choose to discard 3 Basic energy from Raging Bolt ex. Does the damage go through or does Bastiodon's "Ancient Bulwark" Ability prevent it?
a: Bellowing Thunder does damage first, and then the energy is discarded. So Ancient Bulwark would not prevent the damage because it was done before the energy was discarded.

q: If Mega Lopunny ex only has 2 energy attached and I use its "Spiky Hopper" attack against an opponent with Bastiodon's "Ancient Bulwark" Ability on the Bench, does the damage get blocked or not? Where does the protection effect of Ancient Bulwark reside?
a: While the effect of Ancient Bulwark originates from the Benched Bastiodon, it resides on all of that player's Pokemon including the Active Pokemon. So in this scenario, the damage would not be blocked because Spiky Hopper's attack damage ignores any effects on the opponent's Active Pokemon.

q: What happens if I use Dusknoir's "Cursed Blast" Ability and target a Banette with the "Hide 'n' Sneak" Ability?
a: Dusknoir is KO'd and the opponent takes a prize, but Hide 'n' Sneak prevents the damage counters from being placed on Banette.

q: Would Flutter Mane's "Midnight Fluttering" Ability turn off an Active Basic Pokemon's "Hide 'n' Sneak" Ability?
a: Hide 'n' Sneak takes precedence over Midnight Fluttering. It doesn't matter which one comes into play first. Hide 'n' Sneak keeps working.

q: What happens if I use Annhiliape's "Destined Fight" to attack a Pokemon with Mist Energy attached?
a: Annhiliape is KO'd and the opponent takes a prize, but Mist Energy prevents the Defending Pokemon from being KO'd.

q: If Festival Grounds is in play and I use Dipplin's "Festival Lead" Ability to attack a Pokemon ex twice, if I had played Kieran and chose the bonus damage option, would it apply only once or would it apply for both attacks?
a: It would do +30 damage each time you attack a Pokemon ex during the turn. So if the first attacked Pokemon is an ex it would take +30 damage, and if it got KO'd the second attack would also do +30 if the opponent promotes another Pokemon ex. The converse is also true; if the first Pokemon is not a Pokemon ex Kieran would not apply, but if it got KO'd and they promote a Pokemon ex it would take +30 more damage.

q: If Risky Ruins is in play and I play an Antique Armor Fossil, do I place damage counters on it?
a: Yes, damage counters are placed. It counts as a Pokemon when it is put into play.
